title: Cancer, you're allowed to come home too
caption: for the cancers who feed everyone else first

scenes.text: cancer, the moon is up, so i know you're awake.
she rules you, which explains the tides.
you feel a room before you've walked into it.
you make everyone a home, then wait by the door.
the shell isn't the problem. you're allowed a shell.
the problem is you only open it to give.
let someone cook for you. let them be clumsy at it.
let them learn you slowly, the way you learn everyone.
it has to be mutual, even for the one who takes care.
you can be someone's home and still get to come home.
tonight, let someone else set the table.
